notes: Pi emits Start at handoff or the first mapped event. These frames omit response.created, which is the Opi Start trigger.
Tool arguments in the Rust SDK are carried as JSON text. The updated fixture compares the parsed object to the Pi tool arguments.
Opi also retains the reported response model. The pinned Pi output keeps the requested model.

The unknown_503 incomplete reason makes Pi's message retry predicate return true on both transports. The Rust fixture asserts terminal whole-call classification with the same raw reason and a fixed diagnostic.
The prepared SSE fixture leaves the body open after its first terminal and a late failure frame. The updated adapter exposes only the terminal callback and the peer observes body release.
The cached continuation control reuses one WebSocket and sends one delta item with previous_response_id from a response.done terminal carrying end_turn false.
